Case #162

Description

The above patient, a 48-year-old woman, sought breast augmentation in Kalispell in order to enhance her natural silhouette and increase her self-confidence. Standing 62 inches tall and weighing 120 pounds, she led a healthy lifestyle. The patient recognized the potential benefits of the procedure in achieving her desired physical aesthetic and committed herself to the process.The patient underwent a bilateral breast augmentation using silicone implants, each measuring 240cc. This particular approach allowed for a proportional increase in the size of her breasts, leading to a fuller and more balanced appearance. Photos both before and after the procedure illustrate the transformative yet natural results, achieved four months post-op.Michael Hromadka, M.D., an American Board of Plastic Surgery-certified physician, performed the procedure at Mountain West Plastic Surgery in Kalispell, Montana. Known for his expertise in the field of cosmetic surgery, Dr. Hromadka continually strives to deliver natural-looking results. His dedicated approach to each patient's unique needs and overall wellness supports a positive and empowering surgical experience. As showcased through this case, breast augmentation in Kalispell can be a positive step towards achieving personal aesthetic goals under the guidance of a highly skilled and caring provider such as Dr. Hromadka.
